verdicts.criticalReason: The PR modifies the ROOT .gitignore file (adds target/, *.class, .idea/, etc.), which directly violates the explicit Boundaries instruction: 'Never edit the ROOT .gitignore... if your slice genuinely needs to ignore build artifacts, add or extend a nested .gitignore scoped to your own package/directory (e.g. frontend/.gitignore) instead - never the shared root file.'
